notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
Last week I mentioned I would post a road map for the coming weeks/months. I would like to take a moment to do this now. At the moment, this is my list of things I want to get added to the game:
• Bounty Board / Random events tied to bounty hunting
• Prison and Courtroom areas for crime related random events
• Profile Customization / Cosmetic rewards
• Election Process / features for those elected
• Enemy factions / quest line for hostile elected ruler
• Mercenary Synergies / mercenary balance around player verse player combat
• Raid Content
• Additional crafting options
• Bestiary / Game Manual
• Better Tutorial / New Player Help

[h3]January[/h3]
As of now, the bounty system and a few of the random events are ready. I was hoping I would have more complete and ready, but this is not the case. Player verse player content is tied to the bounty system, so I will work to get mercenary combat balanced out this week so I can release an update by the end of the month. Also in development, players will soon be able to earn cosmetic rewards that can be displayed on their player profiles. More details will be released concerning these at a future time.

[h3]February[/h3]
For the month of February, I plan to develop and release the Election process. The whole point of the game is to become a sovereign elect, and this will finally be added to the game during February. Because I've dragged by feet getting the reputation system going, everything else has had to wait. I suppose there was so much to work on, I simply got overwhelmed. By the end of February, I'm hoping the election systems are all in and functioning as desired.

[h3]March[/h3]
For the month of March, any additional content that I has come up in development will be worked on. A bestiary or guide book of information will need to be added to the game. Also, more help for new players.

notes.title: v.0.0.7.3
notes.content:
Reverted a couple changes regarding cooldowns. The mailboxes should be persistent now when offline. Also fixed a crash when accepting a quest, which was tied to receiving a certain quest before unlocking the map expansion. I was hoping to release a few of the random events, but due to errors, I am delaying the release until it is more stable.

I just wanted to take a moment to express my thanks for those who have been supporting me throughout this game development journey. The last couple weeks have been a bit discouraging due to a corruption of some game files, and a large amount of work still needing to be done. I have noticed that I am burning out, and I've been looking for excuses not to work on this game. The scope of the game has grown more than I initially planned, and it is overwhelming me at this rate.

This being said, I will be working on a new roadmap for the next two months. By next week, I hope to have random events ready with a road map for the rest of this month and the next.

[h3]Rat Catcher Rework:[/h3]
It has been some time but changes are finally here. With the addition of resources and crowds, the rat catcher is now tailored to help with resource gathering. His new ability now will spawn a pack of rats that will behave like the crowds that spawn. It will not persist on field if you leave.

While resources, crowds, or rats are on the field, collecting another ability token will spawn a rat counter that will help fill the bars dependent on the rat catcher's level. While this counter is active, each tick can spawn a token from the resource it is helping gather. When a bar is filled, the rat counter will go away until the ability is toggled again. There is a chance for two pack of rats to appear if there is no resource or crowd present in the field.

notes.title: v.0.0.4.9

• tweaked a few things regarding mercenary speed to help reduce path-finding errors

[h3]Crowd Feature Added:[/h3]
When you retrieve a full mailbox, or while collecting merit, there's a small chance a crowd may appear.
Crowds have a similar look to the resources you can collect, but they have a duration of 5 minutes. Collect merit near the crowd to fill its bar. When full, there will be a reward drop based off the level of the crowd. It will then disappear and ping the map icon. If you open your map, one of the fields should have small flickers nearby. This indicates a crowd is present at this location. You may still have time to go there and collect merit to fill it. Each time a crowd relocates, it has a chance to increase its level. When a crowd relocates to an area preciously visited, its level may decrease.

At the moment, crowds are functional but they are not complete. Expect more changes regarding crowds in the future.

[h3]Musical Instruments Added:[/h3]
At the Castle Azure location, you can buy a musical instrument that you can be deployed in a field where you collect merit. Doing so will passively refresh the activities, allowing you to gather merit more efficiently. Only one musical instrument can be in use at a time, but they don't expire.

[h3]Noble Academy Area Added: [/h3]
Players can now access the Noble Academy area [i](partly)[/i]. At the moment, there are two shops and a quest giver. For now, there are a few quests that introduce a new item, Mailboxes. This feature is missing a couple of things, so it is not fully complete.

[h3]Mailboxes Added:[/h3]
Mailboxes can be purchased at the Noble Academy. You can collect one of each type, and you only can place one mailbox per field location. Your mailboxes will gather merit overtime. When full, you can retrieve the mailbox for the merit it has collected. Items will drop as well. When offline, mailboxes will continue to fill. When online, mailboxes will fill at double the rate.

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
Bags will now gather all token items. Due to this change, token duration has been decreased a bit. (These changes are not final and will be further tested)
Autosaves are triggered more frequently.
A couple of miscellaneous code changes were make in hopes to eliminate game breaking bugs.

[h3]What Next?:[/h3]
The Rat Catcher's ability will get a rework.
A mailbox feature I was unable to implement this patch will be added in the next.

notes.title: Temporary Leave for Studio Moving
notes.content:
I just wanted to take a moment to announce that I will be undergoing a major move, and I will be setting up a new studio to work from. During this next week and a half, I will not be able to make any updates for the game. I was hoping to release one today, but I've run out of time. I thank you for your patience.

When I return and am ready to work, I'll get the next patch ready for you. This will include:
1) A large crafting update!
- Items (such as the shovel) will no longer give stat boosts. All items your mercenaries can hold will have abilities of their own.
- Gloves will only give a stat boost to the mercenary it is attached to.

2) You will be able to purchase slots to store crafted items.

For the remainder of the month, I hope to follow the roadmap and get things ready for unlocking the guild areas and reputation system. With this, there will be a focus on multiplayer interactions and more quests for you to do. I will be fixing bugs too, of course.

That is the plan.

notes.title: Early Access & Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866438/baa57e553acb852861dc00f1ac898837d247d778.png[/img]
[i]Sovereign Elect will be available to play in Early Access 7/22 Morning (~9 PST).[/i] This choice has been made in hopes that money can be raised to help support the game moving forward, even though the game is still rather young in development. It is free-to-play, so all funds raised will be through downloadable content. The goal for the game's full release is November of this year. This being said, a road map for the game's development is provided. I hope you join me in this magical journey.

Sovereign Elect initially started out as a role-playing adventure game by design, but due to a number of circumstances, there was no way to finish the project with the current budget. A pivot in design was made, taking heavy inspiration from Bee Swarm Simulator on Roblox. In many ways, Sovereign Elect seeks to be a clone of this game in addition to having its own identity. Currently, Sovereign Elect has three regions for the player to explore and gather resources from. A handful of features are in the game with many more to come in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866438/b201c2398f8d4d26b15131ac6aeb00bd41509456.png[/img]
[h3]July Goals:[/h3]
• Have the game in a playable state and enter early access.
• Have three regions available for the player.
• Multiplayer visibility/limited interactions
• Majority of mercenaries are available for the player.
• Introduce crafting
• Add a timed trial activity (in region 3)

The objective for this month is to get the game in player's hands and to make sure things are working and playable. This is a good time to see what aspects of the game are fun, and kind of things players want in future updates. Multiplayer interaction will be extremely limited during this time unfortunately.
Before August comes around, a timed trial activity will be added. This will help shape game balance moving forward once made available.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866438/3f2ef9881e7bfe8199be3003fab56198395886f3.png[/img]
[h3]August Goals:[/h3]
• Expand map for regions 4+
• Expand crafting system
• Add event notifications
• Multiplayer interaction additions

During this month, the studio will be undergoing a major move. Due to this, development will halt for roughly two to three weeks. The goal for this month is to add to the systems currently in place. A couple new areas are planned to be added in addition to the increased map size.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866438/bb0461590dc7a134b29ada410a1064aa045128b5.png[/img]
[h3]September Goals:[/h3]
• Regions 5+ available
• Introduce guilds and reputation system
• Further Multiplayer interaction additions

The main focus for this month is to have guild regions added and available for the player to explore. The player can gain reputation with guilds which will grant players different benefits. Reputation also is planned to be affected by multiplayer interactions, which could lead to random events and guild reactions.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866438/194f6b71f3c6f46d0be0870b1a25fd48859e8bff.png[/img]
[h3]October Goals:[/h3]
• Guilds fully implemented
• Introduce END-GAME mechanics
• Multiplayer fully implemented (raids/group gathering/etc)

The goal for this month is to build a foundation where players can opt into the sovereign election to become king/queen. When a player becomes the sovereign of the kingdom, they are granted special privileges. All sovereign elects will have privileges of their own. These powers granted to players have a limited duration tied to their game activity. When time runs out, a new election will take place, and the process repeats itself.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866438/ec5f2cfb384f44b6348c577a006a2ce97add6cd2.png[/img]
[h3]November Goals:[/h3]
• END-GAME fully implemented
• Exit Early Access - Full Release

The game becomes feature complete and leaves early access this month. No major changes will be planned from this time moving forward.

notes.title: Demo Status Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Demo Status[/h2]
One mentioned in the previous update that more items and areas will be added. Due to the amount of additions, and some code reworking because of engine updates, it is best to leave the demo alone for the time being.

With early access release coming up, the primary focus has recently been to make the main game build playable. This will include language translations, steam stats, and other features. Depending on time, it may be beneficial to let players opt in for a test run for last minute bug fixing on the main game before it goes live. An update will be posted regarding this in the coming week or so. Until then, thank you for playing the demo.

notes.title: Demo v2 Patch
notes.content:
These are the patch notes for update v.2.0.

[h2]Mercenary Voices[/h2]
* Alchemist voices have been added.
* Bounty Hunter voices have been added.
* Fury voices have been added.
* Paladin voices have been added.
* Priest voices have been added.
* Proctor voices have been added.
* Royal Guard voices have been added.
* Seer voices have been added.
* Assassin voices have been added.
* Buccaneer voices have been added.
* Cleric voices have been added.
* Enchanter voices have been added.
* Knight voices have been added.
* Warlock voices have been added.

* Mercenaries have a voice line for when you 1) start the game, 2) give them an item, 3) when they level up, 4) when they take damage, 5) when they are prestiged. There is RNG for some of the voice lines to not toggle, to prevent mercenaries from talking too much. 
* Only mercenaries visible on screen can talk. [i]If there are subtitles but no audio, this is a bug.[/i]

[h2]Misc Fixes[/h2]
* Prestiged mercenaries now save.
* Prestige multipliers now apply the appropriate stat buff [i](x1.5 attack,gather,conversion stats)[/i]
* Mercenary gloves move with their portrait counterpart when their group is toggled.
* Mercenary ability icons that appear will display their appropriate text while hovered. [i]Note that not all the abilities themselves are feature complete yet, so some abilities will do nothing when collected.[/i]
* The 'Hireling' mercenary tag is changed to white, while the rare mercenaries names are grey.
* When giving an item to a mercenary, the popup will display the correct number of items needed for the next level up if you have more than the required amount
* Also adjusted the checkmark to give 1 item by default while the textbox is left blank
* Display for coins disappearing has been slowed to give the player more time to collect them.
* Quests now track mercenaries in all groups instead of the first and second. Levels should now be tracked as well.
* The game will auto save roughly every minute, and it will also save when a new mercenary is added/changed.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
I did not add 'beers' or 'coffees' due to them being area locked. Also, it will require a new save file, which will crash the game if you were to start over. [i](you would have to manually delete your file to prevent the crash)[/i] Instead, I am making the transition to have all the save data the steam database. This will take some time, but once finished, all the testing will take place on the main application instead of the demo.

As for other things, I am finalizing abilities and prestige buffs for all the characters and will be added next patch. I will release a code to give temporary items for testing purposes when this rolls out.
